the dual form, although the earlier phrase is singular, intensifies the sense of openhandedness.","anchor":"وقوله بل يداه مبسوطتان كناية عن كرمه","mentions":[]},{"verses":["111:1"],"words":["تبت يدا أبي لهب"],"type":"rhetoric","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The wording draws attention to Abu Lahab’s destination: his end is the Fire of the Flame.","anchor":"ثامنها التنبيه على مصيره كقوله تعالى","mentions":["111:3"]},{"verses":["111:4"],"words":["حمالة الحطب"],"type":"meaning","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"حمالة الحطب means a slanderer and also points to the woman’s final destination as fuel for Hell.","anchor":"أي نمامة ومصيرها إلى ان تكون حطبا لجهنم","mentions":[]},{"verses":["5:79","4:66","2:24"],"words":["لبئس ما كانوا يفعلون","ولو أنهم فعلوا ما يوعظون به","فإن لم تفعلوا ولن تفعلوا"],"type":"rhetoric","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"A concise verb can stand for several actions; in فإن لم تفعلوا ولن تفعلوا the omitted actions are producing a sura like the Qur’an, which they will never produce.","anchor":"تاسعها قصد الاختصار ومنه الكناية عن افعال","mentions":[]},{"verses":["20:5"],"words":["الرحمن على العرش استوى"],"type":"rhetoric","speaker":"الزمخشري","stance":"reports","claim":"Al-Zamakhshari treats الاستواء على العرش as a metonym for sovereignty, since sitting on a throne occurs only with kingship.","anchor":"وهذه الكناية استنبطها الزمخشري وخرج عليها","mentions":[]},{"verses":["39:67"],"words":["والأرض جميعا قبضته يوم القيامة"],"type":"rhetoric","speaker":"الزمخشري","stance":"reports","claim":"Al-Zamakhshari’s method reads the earth’s being in God’s grasp as a metonym for majesty and grandeur, without construing grasp and right hand literally or figuratively as separate terms.","anchor":"الآية انه كناية عن عظمته وجلالته","mentions":[]},{"verses":["20:12"],"words":["فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ"],"type":"theology","speaker":"فخر الدين الرازي","stance":"rejects","claim":"Fakhr al-Din al-Razi objects that this broad metonymic method opens the door to esoteric reinterpretations, such as reading Moses’ command to remove his shoes as total devotion rather than an actual command about shoes.","anchor":"وقد اعترض الامام فخر الدين على ذلك","mentions":[]}]}
